name: @fyeeme/pi-subagents
description: General-purpose subagent fan-out for pi: a `subagent` tool (single/parallel) spawning real pi subprocesses, three-source agent discovery (user/project/bundled), plus the shared dispatch core (spawnAgent, per-call abort, maxTurns budget, concurrency ceiling) and the live agent UI (above-editor widget, FleetView, /agents). Successor of @fyeeme/pi-subagent-core.
author: fyeeme
